content: 1. Aluminum hydroxide decreases the levels or effects of mycophenolate by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. It is recommended to avoid this combination or use an alternative drug. If co-administration is necessary, separate the doses by at least 2 hours and monitor the patient closely. 2.
